skill.name: obs-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with OBS Studio or needs workflows for stream assets and overlays, scenes and sources, audio, capture and performance, output settings, plugins, runtime control, or OBS guidance. Routes each workflow by required durable state among Manus asset and site creation, deterministic file and log analysis, a separately proven authenticated OBS protocol client, and OBS Desktop through Computer Use.
skill.userDescription: Build and optimize streaming scenes, sources, audio, and outputs.
exampleQuestions: Design an OBS scene collection for a live webinar.
Help me diagnose dropped frames in OBS Studio.
Create a checklist for OBS audio and streaming settings.
